snippet.title: Match Point Tennis VR - Official Summer Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Match Point Tennis VR trailer to see what's coming in the sports game's summer update, featuring daily, weekly, and seasonal challenges. The Summer Update will also feature new ways to grow, trophies to unlock, new customization options, the opportunity to rise through the ranks, and more. Match Point Tennis VR is available on Meta Quest.
